# TransUnion Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Marketing Mix Modeling Solutions


## Recognition reflects Gartner’s evaluations of ‘Completeness of Vision’ and ‘Ability to Execute’


TransUnion (NYSE: TRU) has been named a Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for


[Marketing Mix Modeling](https://www.transunion.com/solution/truaudience/analytics?utm_campaign=Press+Release++2026+Gartner+MMM+Magic+Quadrant&utm_keyword=&utm_medium=press-release&utm_source=press-release&utm_content=) (MMM) Solutions for the third consecutive year. Gartner evaluates providers based on their ‘Completeness of Vision’ and ‘Ability to Execute.’


“We have earned Leader recognition for a third consecutive year through our commitment to pushing the boundaries of marketing measurement,” said Brian Silver, EVP of Global Marketing Solutions at TransUnion. “By combining more sophisticated modeling, comprehensive data assets and deep industry expertise, we help brands move beyond assumptions to make high-stakes marketing decisions with greater precision and confidence.”


TransUnion provides scalable implementation options for its MMM solution, from being fully managed by TransUnion to providing the training and resources that help customers self-service. TransUnion also offers options that give smaller organizations access to enterprise-level measurement.


In addition, TransUnion's continuous innovation and AI investments have made data processing within this solution faster and less manual, shortening the path to modeling. The MMM solution is part of a connected suite of tools, including Multi Touch Attribution, that all work together to help marketers gain insights and make critical decisions confidently.


TransUnion delivers data-driven insights that connect analytics to action, helping businesses plan, measure, and optimize with confidence. Learn more about TransUnion’s


[TruAudience analytics solutions](https://www.transunion.com/solution/truaudience/analytics?utm_campaign=Press+Release++2026+Gartner+MMM+Magic+Quadrant&utm_keyword=&utm_medium=press-release&utm_source=press-release&utm_content=) .
